## ResolvableReferenceData type

Data of any reference to `Resources` that a client can resolve: a target, containers, and entries that each record their resolving operation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ResolvableReferenceData<Resources extends ResourceTable> =
  | ResolvableObjectReferenceData<Resources>
  | ResolvableCollectionReferenceData<Resources>
```

**References:** [ResourceTable](./contracts.resourcetable.md)<!-- -->, [ResolvableObjectReferenceData](./contracts.resolvableobjectreferencedata.md)<!-- -->, [ResolvableCollectionReferenceData](./contracts.resolvablecollectionreferencedata.md)

## Remarks

This is what `bindReference` admits for a client created from a contract with this table. For a table whose keys are not known, it is every [ReferenceData](./contracts.referencedata.md)<!-- -->.
